create.title: Texas7k lower-convex-cost scenario, redistribution
create.request: Lower the weighted prices at buses [230209, 230220, 230224] using redistribution. Show the consequences elsewhere.
create.interpretation: Minimize the sum of selected active-power marginal prices. Changes are relative to the captured source state. The inner costs use the explicitly recorded lower convex envelope of the source curves; this is a different economic scenario, not the original nonconvex OPF.

rationale: Investigate the high-price load region and the limiting 230273-230267 corridor identified in the exact starting solution. Rank feasible moves with the implicit gradient and require an exact improvement above the recorded numerical tolerance.
